主要内容: Schweitzer-Mauduit International, Inc. filed a 8-K on April 27, 2012, to disclose the results of a shareholder vote on the ratification of Deloitte & Touche's selection as the Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm. The proposal received 14,653,433 votes in favor, 82,600 against, and 5,319 abstentions. The report was signed by Jeffrey A. Cook, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer, on behalf of the registrant.
